verified.evidence: CreateCampaignBookingUseCase delegates inventory reservation to InventoryService, which locks at InventoryService.php:48 (lockForUpdate). The use case owns the transaction. Verified by tests/Feature/Golden/GoldenConcurrencyVerificationTest.php and BookingConcurrencyTest.

RescheduleBookingUseCase wraps its work in DB::transaction (line 63) and delegates eligibility to BookingCapacityService, self-excluding the booking being rescheduled. Documented to preserve the same lock ordering.

retry.mechanism: DB::transaction(..., attempts: 5) on retryable deadlock paths

known_test_failures.test: Tests\Feature\BookingConcurrencyTest > second booking rejected after first consumes last unit
known_test_failures.note: Message-wording only; the rejection itself is enforced. Not caused by remediation.

known_test_failures.test: Tests\Feature\CampaignBookingPricingIntegrityTest > booking rejects quantity over fleet availability

residual_risk.title: Booking model events run inside the caller's transaction
residual_risk.detail: Loyalty and referral side effects are triggered from Eloquent events, so their commit/rollback is bound to whichever transaction the caller opened. Changing this changes financial and loyalty outcomes.

residual_risk.title: VerifyPaymentUseCase has no row lock on the duplicate-verification check
residual_risk.detail: The duplicate guard plus the Razorpay signature make a double-apply very unlikely, but two concurrent verify calls for the same order are not serialised by a lock.

verdict: No new concurrency defect introduced. Two golden concurrency tests pass; the 2 failures are message-wording drift, not behaviour.
